key_insight: ClassEval-Pro fills the gap between function-level synthesis and repo-level edits by providing a scalable, contamination-resistant benchmark specifically for class-level (compositional) code generation across domains.
problem_solved: Evaluates and benchmarks LLMs' ability to generate complete, internally structured classes from specifications—addressing limited, manual, or contaminated existing evaluations that don't capture compositional class creation.
method: Assemble a large, cross-domain corpus of real-world classes via automated extraction from repositories, with rigorous decontamination (temporal splits, dataset deduplication, train/test leak checks).
Define standardized class-level tasks and difficulty tiers plus multi-faceted evaluation: functional unit tests, structural/behavioral checks (APIs, invariants), and interface compliance.
Provide an automated evaluation pipeline and baseline LLM results (quantitative comparisons across domains, languages, and compositional complexity).
impact: Gives practitioners a reproducible, domain-diverse way to measure and improve LLMs' ability to synthesize modular, production-ready code structures—enabling targeted model development and more reliable benchmarking for real-world software tasks.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: data collection → decontamination → task generation → automated evaluation
Heatmap/bar chart: model performance by domain, language, and difficulty tier
Class schematic: annotated class showing fields, methods, invariants, and inter-method dependencies to illustrate compositional complexity
Metric icons: pass rate (unit tests), structural correctness (API match), and contamination-safety badge
paper_title: ClassEval-Pro: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Class-Level Code Generation
paper_authors: Yeheng Chen, Chaoxiang Xie, Yuling Shi, Wenhao Zeng, Yongpan Wang
